comment: Descriptions the endpoint must not spend money answering as a general-purpose model. Each case says which layer should stop it: 'screen' means the server-side pre-check refuses before any API call (and before any credit moves); 'gate' means the request is allowed through but anything that is not a compiling ISF shader is discarded by the output gate, so the caller gets a shader or an error, never an essay. The screen is tested in ShaderCreditsTest (no credit spent on a refusal); the gate cases can also be run live with generate.mjs to watch what a model actually does with them.
